dimension_probe: Qwen3-4B API default is 1024; explicit dimensions=2560 returned 2560. Final scored run uses explicit 2560. See dimension-probe.json.

quality_metrics.Recall@5: For each question: fraction of required evidence groups first found at ranks 1..5; macro mean over 240 questions.
quality_metrics.MRR@10: For each question: mean reciprocal first-hit rank over required evidence groups, missing by rank10 contributes zero; macro mean over 240 questions. This is multi-group MRR, not just the first hit of any group.
quality_metrics.evidence_coverage@10: Fraction of expect_points that occur as literal substrings after whitespace removal in concatenated top10 questions:answer text, macro mean over 240 questions; mechanical coverage, not semantic/answer correctness.

labels: Section substring aliases OR within each group; multiple groups required. D_absent excluded from quality metrics.
timing: 352 texts/model, 52 documents + 300 queries; batch8; 7 document and 38 query calls; sequential single pass, no warmup; elapsed network + queue + inference + retries. Not single-query latency or isolated model compute.
api_input_length: No client truncation or common token cap; provider tokenizer/truncation/precision/hardware are not independently observed.
validation: 52/300 counts, five buckets of60, unique IDs/queries, nonempty group aliases, target sections and answer points present; 500 comparisons against original metric functions; cutoff and exact-cosine checks; cached vectors recomputed for all models.
